properties.name: dataflow.engine.batching.max-files-per-batch
properties.description: Files a streaming flow reads per micro-batch

properties.name: dataflow.engine.batching.max-records-per-file
properties.description: Most rows written per Parquet file

properties.name: dataflow.engine.cache-dir
properties.description: Directory for downloaded sources and task files

properties.name: dataflow.engine.lake-root
properties.description: Where the lake is (s3a://, abfss://, gs://, file:); its scheme picks the connector settings

properties.name: dataflow.engine.maintenance.enabled
properties.description: Run OPTIMIZE and VACUUM after a run

properties.name: dataflow.engine.maintenance.interval
properties.description: Least time between two maintenance passes of a dataset

properties.name: dataflow.engine.maintenance.retention-hours
properties.description: Hours deleted Delta files are kept before VACUUM removes them

properties.name: dataflow.engine.pipelines-location
properties.description: Folder of specs used when a run names no release (development)

properties.name: dataflow.engine.releases-root
properties.description: Where releases are read from

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.collection
properties.description: ClickHouse named collection that reaches the lake

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long a run waits to connect to ClickHouse

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.database
properties.description: ClickHouse database the serving flow publishes to

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.enabled
properties.description: Publish tables to ClickHouse at the end of a run

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.password
properties.description: Password of the ClickHouse service user

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.refresh-every
properties.description: Refresh interval of copy tables' materialized views

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.timeout
properties.description: How long a run waits for one ClickHouse statement, a table copy included

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.url
properties.description: ClickHouse HTTP address

properties.name: dataflow.engine.serving.user
properties.description: ClickHouse service user

properties.name: dataflow.engine.sources.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long a run waits to connect to a source URL

properties.name: dataflow.engine.sources.timeout
properties.description: How long a run waits for one source file to download; raise it for large files on slow links

properties.name: dataflow.engine.tasks.clean
properties.description: Lake locations a clean task removes, base64, one per line (set by the tower)

properties.name: dataflow.engine.tasks.draft
properties.description: Draft spec of a preview task, base64 (set by the tower)

properties.name: dataflow.engine.tasks.sample-rows
properties.description: Rows a preview or inference task samples

properties.name: dataflow.engine.tasks.transformations
properties.description: Draft transformation sources of a preview task, base64 (set by the tower)

properties.name: dataflow.spark.app-name
properties.description: Spark application name

properties.name: dataflow.spark.checkpoint-managers
properties.description: Streaming checkpoint manager per lake scheme

properties.name: dataflow.spark.config
properties.description: Spark settings applied to every session (spark profile)

properties.name: dataflow.spark.stores
properties.description: Spark settings per storage scheme, applied for the roots a run touches
